name: unsafe fn grow_zeroed (& self , ptr : NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : Layout , new_layout : Layout ,) -> Result < NonNull < [u8] > , AllocError >
rule: After a successful call to `grow_zeroed`, bytes `old_layout.size()..old_size` must each be preserved or zeroed, where `old_size` is the size of the memory block before the call and may exceed the size originally requested.
api: trait Allocator  : { unsafe fn grow_zeroed (& self , ptr : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < u8 > , old_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout , new_layout : core::alloc::layout::Layout ,) -> core::result::Result < core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < [u8] > , core::alloc::AllocError > }
